qualification.reviewer: Codex semantic review, not independent human rating
qualification.conclusion: Both continuations fail the owner conversation and regress the previously coherent readiness answer. Lower validation loss does not imply a usable assistant. Removing replay changes the failure from narratives to malformed or unrelated chat formulas.
limits: One seed, one small model and one existing data set; no statistical or general-intelligence conclusion.
At the same optimizer-step budget, replay changes the number and order of dialogue updates and total tokens seen.
The language guard is configured only for the replay arm; every measured replay-arm state passed it, so no checkpoint was excluded by that guard.
All conversation probes are now known development cases; no claim of independent human evaluation.
